Thought: I need to determine the correct definition of the hazard statement H281. Hazard statements are standardized phrases used in the classification and labeling of hazardous chemicals under the Globally Harmonized System (GHS). Each hazard statement has a unique code starting with "H" followed by three digits.

H281 specifically refers to a physical hazard related to gases under pressure. Let me recall what this specific hazard statement means.

H281 is the hazard statement for "Contains refrigerated gas; may cause cryogenic burns or injury." This applies to refrigerated liquefied gases which are extremely cold and can cause tissue damage similar to burns (cryogenic burns) upon contact.

Looking at the options:
A. Contains refrigerated gas; may cause cryogenic burns or injury - This matches the definition of H281
B. Explosive - This would be a different hazard statement
C. Extremely flammable gas - This would be a different hazard statement
D. Very sensitive - This is not a standard hazard statement wording
